notes.title: News from developers
notes.notes:
[img]https://pp.userapi.com/c639518/v639518288/9059/JS2UKO3mtRc.jpg[/img]

The project is in the stage of total rework. Therefore, we can not release the update until we finish all the work.

The global update is scheduled to be released by May 9, unless we have time to finish everything by that time.

Main works:

- Strategic mode, saving / loading of the current server state, settlements capture system / other important points, upgrading units (number of personnel, fuel for equipment), range of visibility (intelligence units have the advantage).
The "Defense" and "Ambush" modes are affect the initial respawns in combat. In the "Defense" mode we want to make an additional defensive sites.

- Weapons upgrades for each rank, in the main menu as a "Shop". Weapons are opened for each class separately, for accumulated global team points. List of ranks and weapons to them is in development. In the near future we will show how this looks like in the game. We work on storage / reading from the database, working on the models, animations, etc. In the future we will add different camouflage, skins, helmets / hats, etc.

- Tanks. It was decided to completely redesign the system. The tower and chassis will be in the form of different systems, which makes it possible programming everything more and more in detail (note: a critical hit on the tower disables it, etc.). It is in the early stages of development.

- Ranks. Assigned for every 5 th level (note: a player with 10 lvl will be in the game as a junior sergeant). The current level of players in the game will remain.

It is possible to enumerate for a long time what has already been done (blasting of fences and other objects with the help of a high-explosive grenade, closing of hatches at Sdkfz 222, the shooter hides in the tower in aiming mode and vice versa, we want to make interactive hatches / doors for all equipment, return to the concept of "bolts" "- one shot - one corpse) and much much more.

Special thanks to people who help us in testing and development, those who gratuitously devote time to our game, looking for errors, gives us practical advice, and corrects us when we are making wrong moves. Thank you, friends, on behalf of the whole team.

notes.title: Новости от разработчиков
notes.notes:
- Игра делится на 2 разных режима - стратегический и тактический. В дальнейшем, чтобы не было путаницы, именовать их будем так.
- Написана новая качественная музыка под игру (под стратегический и тактический режимы). OST так же будет доступен для приобретения.
- Реализована стратегическая сетевая кампания.
- Реализована "Прокачка" всех используемых в игре классов, настройка каждого класса, выбор, открытие оружия и другое.
- Реализована "Прокачка" званий в игре, от рядового до полковника.
- Создано 20 новых локаций под стратегическую кампанию (поля, леса, дороги, деревни, города и т.д.)
- Множество новых объектов: Городские дома, бункеры и многое другое.
- Новый риг всех персонажей.
- Исправление некоторых анимаций у персонажей.
- Выключен огонь по своим.
- Новая система боев для тактического режима (без флагов).

Новое оружие:
- Пистолеты (ТТ-33 и Вальтер П-38).
- Винтовка Мосина.
- ППС-43.
- FG-42.

Новая техника:
- Sdkfz 222.
- БА-6.

Обновление планируем выпустить в конце апреля - начале мая.
Спасибо тем, кто в нас верит.

notes.title: News from developers
notes.notes:
- The game is divided into 2 different modes - strategic and tactical. In the future, so that there will be no confusion, we will call them so.
- We have written a new high-quality music for the game (for strategic and tactical modes). OST will also be available for purchase.
- Implemented a strategic network campaign.
- Implemented "Leveling" of all classes used in the game, setting up each class, selecting, opening weapons and more.
- Implemented "Leveling" of ranks in the game, from the private to the colonel.
- 20 new locations have been created for the strategic campaign (fields, forests, roads, villages, cities, etc.)
- A lot of new objects: Town houses, bunkers and much more.
- New rig of all characters.
- Fixed some animations for characters.
- Disabled Friendly fire.
- A new system of battles for tactical mode (without flags).

New weapons:
- Pistols (TT-33 and Walter P-38).
- Mosin rifle.
- PPS-43.
- FG-42.

New vehicles:
- Sdkfz 222.
- BA-6.

We plan to release the update in late April or early May.
Thank you to those who believe in us.

notes.title: Update v0.3.16
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27768987/8c6528bae04c1576d6bc5245fcaffdd90f143c76.jpg[/img]

[h1]Greetings, my friends! New update v0.3.16 is here![/h1]
List of changes:


[h1] Gameplay [/h1]
• Introduced "System of dynamic orders" on all maps.
• Added a new order "Driver". Purpose: to deliver the infantry to the front.

[h1] Fixes [/h1]
• Fixed the distance of the layout of the field hospital (before the flag).
• Fixed error of the order timer.
• Fixed bugs related to orders.
• Fixed crates, canisters (life time added).
• Fixed minor bugs.
• Fixed the flight of grenades.
• The action menu has been fixed.

[h1] Other [/h1]
• After the death of the player, the camera appears on the Spawn point.
• After filling the lobby, the order starts automatically.
• Mosin's rifle and K98 now killing with one shot.
• The scatter is increased when firing with PPS.
• The model of med. tent has been increased (so that players can freely enter it).
• Reduced the time of displaying corpses on the map.
• When the account reaches -500 CP, the player excludes from the server automatically.
• The light filter is removed.
• Added 25% to the brightness of the sun.
• Fixed key maping.

notes.title: Devblog #1
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27768987/97f3620db4882370f1e3a625d35b54c2e5b5da35.jpg[/img]

Good day, friends! We are glad to introduce you the "developer diary".
Here you can find out: on what thigs we are working right now and what is just planned to be done in nearest future, and what to expect in the near future.


[h1] «Dynamic orders system» [/h1]

With the introduction of this system access to "Motorized Infantry" will be removed. Now, all vehicles and various facilities are available only with the arrival of new orders.

During combat, players will receive notifications, which will be tell you about the need to support at the front.
Here is the list of tasks that will be available with the release of the update:

• The mission of the field medics.
• The mission of the artillery battery.
• The mission of armored forces.

We are now finalizing the HQ AI ​. It is responsible for the distribution of orders, depending on the intensity of the fighting on the front lines.


[h1] «Decals» [/h1]

[h1] «Dynamic orders system» [/h1]

With the introduction of this system access to "Motorized Infantry" will be removed. Now, all vehicles and various facilities are available only with the arrival of new orders.

During combat, players will receive notifications, which will be tell you about the need to support at the front.
Here is the list of tasks that will be available with the release of the update:

• The mission of the field medics.
• The mission of the artillery battery.
• The mission of armored forces.

We are now finalizing the HQ AI ​. It is responsible for the distribution of orders, depending on the intensity of the fighting on the front lines.

notes.title: Early Access
notes.notes:

Comrades! We are glad to announce that the Fog of War is now in Open Alpha Testing stage, and is available for purchase in the Steam Store!

We believe that a good game can be made only with the active co-operation with our gaming community, and assistance in finding a variety of errors and other troubles.

During testing, our priority aim will be sharpening the gameplay components, bugs fixing, work on existing game features and adding new ones.
